headline: Laser Power & Infra secures Rs 72.76 crore HTLS reconductoring order from POWERGRID
hook: New transmission contract for Laser Power
summary: Laser Power & Infra Limited announced that it has bagged a high-temperature low-sag reconductoring order worth Rs 72.76 crore from Power Grid Corporation of India. The contract involves upgrading power transmission lines using specialized HTLS technology. This order provides revenue visibility for the company's manufacturing division. Retail investors tracking power ancillaries should note the order inflow.
why_it_matters: Order inflow boosts near-term revenue visibility for Laser Power.
